about: Limits for an emulated WebXR session report, and adapter names that mean a software renderer. Working values chosen for mstack; none was read from a primary source. Measure on the target headset and replace them.

max_draw_calls.unit: draw calls per frame, per eye pass as reported by the renderer
max_draw_calls.source: mstack working value, no primary source

max_triangles.source: mstack working value, no primary source

software_renderers.unit: lower-case fragments of a GPU adapter name
software_renderers.source: mstack working list, no primary source
